name: 勤政殿 Qinzheng Dian
line: The emperor's office hall of 勤政亲贤 east of the audience court: five bays with a three-bay porch 抱厦 front and back as the Yangshi Lei plan 勤政殿地盘图样 has it (A) and S01 draws it (B), its walled court before it; every height, the roofs and the court's walls are C.
rows: Five bays facing south with three-bay porches front and rear (勤政殿地盘图样, mhymy ysltd 7310 and 11009, A; S05 j80:11b, A); 22.2 m wide on S01 (B)
Rolled 歇山, grey, the porches' roofs joined to the hall's slopes (C: no picture of the 1860 state; the 1744 leaf shows an earlier one, S41)
勤政亲贤 in front, 为君难 at the back (S05 j80:18a, A; boards C)
As S01 draws it, walled, paved, a gate in its south wall (B; the walls' height and colour C)
In 1837 (most likely) the east study got a front porch, a south door and large glass panes (S211 竹叶亭杂记; not drawn: the interior is out of scope)
